notes.title: The Lair of the Giant Cat
notes.content:
[h1]In this game update, you can expect:[/h1]

[list]
[*]  A new underground location
[*]  A new bad ending
[*]  A new good ending
[*]  New items and quests
[/list]

Pack your backpack, grab as many energy drinks as you can, and head down into the[b] lair of the giant cat, Fred[/b]. You’ll finally get to use that cassette tape in Fred the cat's room! 
[img]http://wildgames.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/002-1024x594.png[/img]
